_readme: Per-member sector overrides, checked before the category-level data/naics_crosswalk.json. Exists because 'Utilities & Internet Service Providers' (17 members) splits almost exactly in half between two different NAICS sectors on inspection -- too material a group to exclude wholesale like the smaller ambiguous categories, but not uniform enough for one category-level answer either. Small enough (17) to classify by hand instead of guessing. Each entry: real business type, not assumed -- verified via web search where not already obviously known.

88.name: Atlanta Gas Light Company
88.note: Natural gas distribution utility (owns the pipes) -- NAICS 2212.

1200.name: SCANA Energy
1200.note: Natural gas marketer/retailer in Georgia's deregulated gas market -- confirmed via web search it does NOT own the distribution pipes (Atlanta Gas Light does), it bills and resells gas to end customers. Lower-confidence call: marketers-without-infrastructure are a genuine NAICS gray area, but Census/QCEW convention still codes retail gas marketers under Utilities (2212), not Retail Trade, so classified there.

3766.name: Donny's Propane Gas
3766.note: Propane delivered to customer premises -- confirmed via web search this is NAICS 454310 'Fuel Dealers,' Retail Trade, not Utilities. Propane dealers don't operate distribution infrastructure the way gas/electric utilities do.

78411.name: Cherry Street Energy
78411.note: Confirmed via web search: builds, owns, and operates solar power systems and sells the electricity directly to customers (City of Atlanta, Emory, Gulfstream, etc.) -- a genuine electric power generator, NAICS 2211, not a solar installer/contractor.

78950.name: Wire 3
78950.note: Confirmed via web search: fiber-optic internet provider expanding into Macon -- NAICS 517, Information.

79092.name: Kinder Morgan
79092.note: Confirmed via web search: operates Southern Natural Gas, an interstate natural gas pipeline system through Georgia. Pipeline Transportation of Natural Gas is NAICS 486210, Transportation and Warehousing (sector 48) -- not Utilities. A common misconception; pipeline transport of gas/oil is classified as transportation, not distribution, under NAICS.

246.name: Burgess Pigment Company
246.note: Kaolin clay mining/processing -- NAICS 212325, Mining, not Manufacturing. Named as a known exception in the 'Industrial, Manufacturing & Logistics' category note but previously folded into Manufacturing anyway; now split out.

71555.name: Atlanta Sand & Supply Co.
71555.note: Sand/aggregate mining -- NAICS 212321, Mining. Same exception group as Burgess Pigment.

78744.name: SCB Minerals, LLC
78744.note: Mineral/aggregate operation -- NAICS 212, Mining. Same exception group as Burgess Pigment.

76733.name: BrightFarms, Inc
76733.note: Hydroponic greenhouse produce grower -- NAICS 111419, Agriculture, not Manufacturing. Named as a known exception in the 'Industrial, Manufacturing & Logistics' category note but previously folded into Manufacturing anyway.

1186.name: Saddle Creek Corporation
1186.note: Third-party logistics/warehousing provider -- NAICS 493, Transportation and Warehousing, not Manufacturing. Named as a known exception in the 'Industrial, Manufacturing & Logistics' category note but previously folded into Manufacturing anyway.

1381.name: FOX 24/ABC16 WGXA - Sinclair Communications, LLC
1381.note: TV broadcaster -- NAICS 5151, Information, not Marketing & Media's default (Advertising Services, sector 54). One of the ~7 broadcasters/publishers named in the 'Marketing & Media' category note but previously folded into 54 anyway.

1382.name: 13 WMAZ - TV
1382.note: TV broadcaster -- NAICS 5151, Information. Same exception group as FOX 24/ABC16 WGXA.

1384.name: WMGT 41NBC
1384.note: TV broadcaster -- NAICS 5151, Information. Same exception group as FOX 24/ABC16 WGXA.

865.name: Macon Magazine
865.note: Print publisher -- NAICS 5111, Information, not Marketing & Media's default. Same exception group as the TV stations.

58307.name: Georgia CEO
58307.note: Online news/media publisher -- NAICS 519130, Information. Same exception group as Macon Magazine.

72876.name: NotiVisión Georgia
72876.note: News/media publisher -- NAICS 519130, Information. Same exception group as Macon Magazine.

76647.name: Georgia Trust for Local News
76647.note: News publisher -- NAICS 519130, Information. Same exception group as Macon Magazine.

72870.name: The Florrest Awakens LLC
72870.note: Event venue, not a hotel -- NAICS 7139, Arts, Entertainment, and Recreation, not Lodging & Venues' default (Accommodation, sector 72). Named as a known exception in the 'Lodging & Venues' category note but previously folded into 72 anyway.

72916.name: Hollywood Farms
72916.note: Event venue, not a hotel -- NAICS 7139, Arts, Entertainment, and Recreation. Same exception group as The Florrest Awakens.

8663.name: Macon Tent Rentals
8663.note: Equipment rental company -- NAICS 532, Real Estate and Rental and Leasing, not Professional & Business Services' default (sector 54). Named as a known exception in that category's note but previously folded into 54 anyway.

78317.name: eco-X.travel, LLC
78317.note: Travel agency -- NAICS 5615, Administrative and Support Services, not Professional & Business Services' default. Named as a known exception in that category's note but previously folded into 54 anyway.

252.name: Butler Automotive Group
252.note: Franchised auto dealer group -- NAICS 4411, Retail Trade. Individually confirmed as part of resolving the 'Automotive' category member-by-member (12 members, 4 different real sectors, previously all forced into Retail).

729.name: Mercedes Benz/Volvo/Subaru of Macon
729.note: Franchised auto dealer -- NAICS 4411, Retail Trade.

1393.name: Walsh Honda
1393.note: Franchised auto dealer -- NAICS 4411, Retail Trade.

1446.name: Butler Chevrolet
1446.note: Franchised auto dealer -- NAICS 4411, Retail Trade.

57572.name: Harley-Davidson of Macon
57572.note: Franchised motorcycle dealer -- NAICS 4411, Retail Trade.

60257.name: Grant's Tire & Auto, LLC
60257.note: Auto repair shop, not a dealer -- NAICS 8111, Other Services (except Public Administration).

1137.name: Raffield Tire Masters, Inc.
1137.note: Confirmed via web search: tire sales and auto repair (brakes, alignment, oil changes) -- NAICS 8111, Other Services, not Retail.

1330.name: Truck and Trailer of Macon, Inc.
1330.note: Confirmed via web search: truck/trailer repair shop (tank testing, welding, refrigeration repair) since 1981 -- NAICS 8113, Other Services, not Retail.

15.name: Ackerman Wrecker Service, Inc.
15.note: Confirmed via web search: towing/recovery company. Motor Vehicle Towing is NAICS 488410, Transportation and Warehousing (Support Activities for Transportation) -- not Retail or a repair service.

56053.name: Excess Incorporated
56053.note: Confirmed via web search: distributes automotive/truck/bus/transportation-related components to businesses -- NAICS 4238, Wholesale Trade, not Retail.

63009.name: Interstate Batteries of Greater Georgia
63009.note: Confirmed via web search: explicitly describes itself as a "battery wholesaler and distributor," part of Interstate Batteries' distributor network -- NAICS 4236, Wholesale Trade, not Retail.

67961.name: Mobile Space Sales & Rental, LLC
67961.note: Confirmed via web search: mobile office trailers and portable storage, sales AND rental -- classified under Rental and Leasing Services (NAICS 532), sector 53, matching the Macon Tent Rentals precedent. Moderate confidence given the sales/rental split.
